info.name: compensation Workers API
info.description: The Compensation service enables applications to extend Workday's HCM Compensation features.

item.name: Request a one-time payment for a worker with the specified ID

variable.description:
(Required) The Workday ID of the resource.

Accepts:
- **Workday ID**: Workday ID (32-character lowercase hexadecimal string).
- **Reference ID**: Workday reference ID (Type=Value). Valid types: Employee_ID, Contingent_Worker_ID
- **Named entry**: Valid values: `me`.

request.description:
Creates a one-time payment for a worker with the specified ID, and initiates the Request One-Time Payment business process. In the request body, specify at least these required fields: reason{id}, position{id}, oneTimePayments[ paymentCurrency{id}, oneTimePaymentPlan {id}].

Sample format for paymentAmount:
"payment Amount": {
"value": "2500"
}

Secured By Business Process Type: Request One-Time Payment

Scope: Core Compensation

response.name:
Invalid request. (https://community.workday.com/rest/error-messages)

A One-Time Payment plan is required.

At least 1 One-Time Payment is required.

Based on the worktag type configuration following worktag types are not valid for taggable type [tt]: [aw

Retrieves a worker instance with the specific ID.

Secured By Domain: FLW Service, Self-Service: Current Staffing Information, Worker Data: Public Worker Reports

Scope: Staffing
